newsitem.title: USA: Double Day Inc Q1 net decreases.
newsitem.headline: Double Day Inc Q1 net decreases.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
NOTE: The 1995 results have been restated to reflect the results of the acquisition of Thompson Recovery in April 1996.

Net income for 1996 included charges and adjustments of $70,000 to start up the company's coal division and ferrous briquetting operations, $41,000 for the acquisition of Thompson Recovery and a non-cash loss of approximately $20,000 on an investment in the Go-Roof Co.
The company said that over $300,000 in cost deferrals on certain inventories were not allowed by Generally Accepted Accounting Principles.
The company said its average shares outstanding increased by two million shares in 1996, which reduced the 1996 earnings per share.
